summary.zh: 面向工程师 NCEES PE 执业考试的备考平台：贴合现行考纲的原创练习题、完整模拟考，以及锚定逐步详解的 AI 导师 Castor。
summary.en: NCEES PE exam preparation for engineers — exam-real practice problems with worked solutions, full-length mock exams, and an AI tutor (Castor) grounded in each solution.

summary.en: Autonomous AI Founder — scans public evidence before you spend months building, returning a confidence score, key risk gaps, and three concrete customer tests.

summary.en: Voice cloning and Chinese dubbing on the GPU print-shop model, plus dubbed founder interview channels from YC, Sequoia, and leading AI toolmakers.

summary.en: Account-free P2P chat, voice/video meetings, and an agent network where your keypair is your identity. ReadyPlayer runs directly on it.

summary.en: US equities research workbench combining TradingView charts, watchlists, and AI-assisted stock research in one workspace.
